explication: This repository snapshot contains Lua site modules for HDoujin Downloader, a general-purpose doujinshi and image-gallery downloader. The documented user workflow is to provide a gallery URL (including by clipboard monitoring) and download its content; the tree shows a large collection of site-specific modules but no application entry point or shared runtime. The README also documents metadata-based organization, chapter tracking, archive conversion, and image conversion/resizing, but their implementations are not present in the supplied tree. The connection to site modules is therefore shown as unverified.
